title: Independent noisy-covariance stress test for thermal-memory reconstruction

amendment.reason: Post-run audit found non-standard Infinity in JSON, hidden sign-changing kernels in plots, missing finite/real and regularized-stability gates, and incomplete failure accounting.
amendment.changes: Save all noisy inputs and attempt reasons; fail on nonfinite/complex values and unstable regularized realizations; evaluate the actual regularized stochastic model; report nonpositive kernel values explicitly with null log-error plus extended-error status; add direct-matrix-exponential evaluation and verification. Sampling, seed, ensemble counts, order/window fallback, and original error thresholds are unchanged.
amendment.historical_outputs: Original version preserved at workspace work/noisy-memory-v1-2026-09-05; its results are superseded by this audited rerun.

status: local protocol frozen before the first full Monte Carlo execution; not externally preregistered
relationship_to_source: Restricted implementation using the published analytic target and order/window fallback. It does not implement Appendix B spectral deletion or negative-real-mode duplication and is not a test of the full published noisy-data method. The untransformed auxiliary realization is evaluated; the optional final Lanczos sweep is not run in this stress test.

data_provenance.generator: Wishart scatter matrices for independent zero-mean Gaussian trajectory vectors with exact Toeplitz target covariance
data_provenance.independence: The generator uses only the analytic covariance and does not call the reconstruction or fitted model.
data_provenance.limitation: Synthetic ensemble-covariance noise is not the correlated finite-trajectory noise of the paper's Lennard-Jones molecular dynamics.

predeclared_outputs: VACF RMSE and kernel log-RMSE among accepted fits
fraction of accepted fits with good VACF but bad kernel
interpretation_limits: No monotonic trend is a required pass condition.
Acceptance means the numerical gates passed, not that the inferred kernel is unique.
Frequency positivity is sampled, not proved over the continuum.
Order fallback changes capacity AND truncates the fitted time window from 11.4 at n=10 to 4.2 at n=4.
Pointwise sign changes in a kernel are not by themselves violations of thermal admissibility; here they disagree with the strictly positive target and make the logarithmic error undefined.
This is not a reproduction of the paper's noisy molecular-dynamics experiment.
